Check the Zariski locality clause from the definition of reducedness (proof lines 5176-5178).
Check preservation: a smooth morphism of affines out of a reduced scheme has reduced source, by the algebra lemma (proof lines 5179-5181).

Apply the criterion and conclude (proof lines 5186-5187).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the property 'S is reduced' is local in the smooth topology (statement lines 5168-5172). The proof verifies the three clauses of the chapter's general criterion for a property of schemes to be local: Zariski locality is clear from the definition of reducedness, preservation is the algebra lemma that a smooth morphism of affines with reduced target has reduced source, and descent is the algebra lemma that a surjective smooth morphism of affines with reduced source has reduced target; the criterion then applies (proof lines 5174-5187). The level is H2: every clause of the criterion is checked explicitly and the two nontrivial ones are named, so the card shows which conditions are being met rather than merely asserting locality.
